fields.summary_ko.0: Microsoft (MSFT) declined 6% from all-time highs due to widespread Outlook, SharePoint, and Copilot outages, but fiscal Q1 (ended September 2027) revenue of $92.3B (19% year-over-year increase) and Azure revenue growth of 48% demonstrated business diversification to absorb the impact.
fields.summary_ko.1: Microsoft recorded operating cash flow of $58B (29% year-over-year increase), free cash flow of $18.6B, and shareholder returns of $10.2B, maintaining a solid financial foundation.
